info.title: Here the World — Shared API Contract
info.description: Development baseline agreed through this project documentation; endpoints are planned, not implemented. Business rules: api-contract.md. Responses use envelopes; all IDs are opaque strings. Unknown request fields are rejected. Public reads with a supplied invalid bearer token return 401.

get.summary: 读取随机但会话内稳定的作品流
get.description: Omit cursor to create a 30-minute public feed snapshot with a random seed. Subsequent cursors preserve seed, cutoff, filters and position, independent of login identity; viewer state is calculated per request. Deleted/unavailable works are skipped. 410 FEED_SESSION_EXPIRED requires explicit refresh; do not silently reorder the current wall.

mediaCookie.name: htw_media
mediaCookie.description: HttpOnly media-read credential scoped to /api/v1/media/private/. Issued on login and refresh. Its lifetime is bounded by the existing session. Every private read checks session expiry, revocation and asset ownership. It authorizes private media GET and HEAD requests.

url.description: Backend-provided media URL. May be a same-origin relative URI. Public media URLs are stable and cacheable for 60 seconds. Private media URLs are stable and require the media-read cookie or Bearer authentication.
